finding: Marr mini-list repeats its heading instead of a distinct third level.
handling: Record the incomplete list, test only the visible goal/method distinction, and do not manufacture a missing third bullet.

finding: The slide assigns white-light dispersion to Newton in1670, while the Newton Project describes experiments beginning1666 and a1672 paper.
handling: Do not quiz1670 as established chronology; retain the source wording in the ledger and test the spectral principle. External context: https://www.newtonproject.ox.ac.uk/texts/introduction .

finding: Spectral product is given without full spectral-density/radiance/geometry conventions.
handling: Questions clearly supply relative band units; calibrated absolute radiometric conclusions are excluded.

finding: CMOS expansion printed Complementary Metal Oxide on Silicon.
handling: Explicitly distinguish standard complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor, supported by Hamamatsu technical note https://hub.hamamatsu.com/us/en/technical-notes/image-sensors/advances-in-cmos-image-sensors.html ; preserve the valid readout comparison.

finding: Gain/exposure prose can conflate amplification with additional light collection.
handling: State fixed illumination and exposure when distinguishing electrical gain from photon count.

finding: Nearest-integer final coordinates are presented as a general rule.
handling: Treat rounding as a specified indexing operation; retain subpixel outputs in geometric calculations. Distinguish pixel homogeneous notation from metric coordinates.

finding: Printed metres(0.0009,0.0012) are equated to(1.5,2.0) mm instead of(0.9,1.2) mm.
handling: Preserve as-printed comment and derive correct conversion explicitly; do not silently replace source output.

finding: SE3 is referenced but not imported; camera is later reassigned with pixel calibration.
handling: Separate as-printed fragments from runnable code with explicit imports and execution order. Defaults verified from official API source, not an installed toolbox runtime.

finding: Boundary-based visibility omits occlusion, and parallel-edge convergence lacks a finite/infinite qualification.
handling: Supply positive depth and explicit bounds; do not infer unoccluded visibility. Distinguish nonzero depth direction from image-plane-parallel directions.

finding: The upper mkgrid call precedes its displayed import; camera and SE3 definitions are external context.
handling: Persist as-printed fragments and a separately repaired full script. Per-call pose semantics checked against official source, not claimed as locally executed toolbox behavior.

finding: The slide claims coplanar edges/lines remain parallel; coplanarity alone does not establish this.
handling: Derive an explicit coplanar parallel-line counterexample and state the correct image-plane-direction condition; qualify depth-direction vanishing points.

finding: mkcube, SE3 and camera are used without a complete initialization block.
handling: Treat as a continuation; keep as-printed fragment and a separate full script with all imports/setup. No local toolbox execution is claimed because dependency installation was denied.
